ruling: karaka dasha roles (SS N-69, S-L1 mandatory)
description: chart_dashas.karaka_role_at_period and karakas_active_during_period (and the karaka_school provenance suffix appended to citation_human on the rows that carry a role claim) follow each chart's OWN ga_sensitive kn_rao_rahu_included karaka_chara_position assignments, read by stored rank, instead of one hard-coded lord->role dict (Sun AK, Mars AmK, Mercury BK, Saturn MK, Jupiter PK, Venus GK, Moon DK) applied to every chart. Rahu now carries a role (the old dict had none); Ketu, sign lords (chara_karaka, kalachakra, narayana) and yogini names stay NULL. NO other chart_dashas column moves: row set, lords, dates, start_iso/end_iso, durations, natal context and tiers are unchanged, and emission order of karakas_active_during_period is unchanged (fixed graha order Sun Mars Mercury Saturn Jupiter Venus Moon, Rahu appended). DETECTOR LIMIT, stated plainly: flip_detector.py reads chart_dashas only as (lord path, start, end) rows, so it cannot see these column values; this hook therefore declares the lane's detector-visible footprint as a zero-second start shift and carries the column-level expectation in this text. Offline OLD-vs-NEW counts (live chart_dashas joined to the stored kn_rao rank->graha assignments per ayanamsha; the old model was first reproduced against stored values with 0 mismatches on all three charts; ayanamsha totals summed across the 5 ayanamshas; systems vimshottari, vimshottari_kp, ashtottari, mudda, naisargika carry the fields): canonical 482012f1 rows with karaka_role_at_period changed 185,883 (value->other value 159,175; NULL->value 26,708 (Rahu lords); value->NULL 0; equal by coincidence 9,630), karakas_active_during_period changed 205,157; chart 1c826d5a role changed 154,981 (127,928 / 27,053 / 0 / equal 42,585), active changed 195,639; chart cb73cd3d role changed 192,473 (161,620 / 30,853 / 0 / equal 30,440), active changed 228,957. chara_karaka, kalachakra, narayana, yogini, scope_cap: 0 rows change. Counts are of the live (pre-rebuild) row sets; a rebuild after the ephemeris flip can shift a few rows at the window edges. Full per-chart per-system table: KARAKA_DASHA_ROLES_INTENT_v1_0.md section 6.

may_change.note: This lane moves no timestamp and adds or removes no row; the entry exists because a hook needs a non-empty may_change and the detector has no per-column vocabulary for chart_dashas. A [0, 0] range cannot attribute any shifted row to this lane (the detector ignores shifts of 2 s or less and only matches larger ones), so it masks nothing the ephemeris lane's own dasha_shift entry must explain. Column-level expectation: karaka_role_at_period and karakas_active_during_period change on the rows whose lord (or parent lord) has a chart-specific role different from the old constant, for the systems listed here only; see description for counts.
